summary: Tested backend (8 pytest: auth register/login/me, AI chat 401/422/SSE error) and UI (landing, register+4-step onboarding -> /today, demo login, Today/Tasks/Habits/Goals/Notes/Journal/Calendar/AI render, task create+reload, GPT 6 Luna selection + fallback). Found and FIXED a CRITICAL session leak in backend/server.py proxy: shared httpx.AsyncClient stored Set-Cookie from login responses in its cookie jar and replayed them on every proxied request, so anonymous visitors got the last-logged-in user's session (/api/v1/auth/me returned demo user with no cookie). After fix all 8 backend tests pass; accounts persist across `supervisorctl restart backend`.

critical.issue: FIXED by testing agent: httpx client cookie jar persisted upstream session cookies -> cross-user session hijack. Now uses CookieJar(DefaultCookiePolicy(allowed_domains=[])) so no cookies are stored.

minor.issue: Not routed (404); health only on upstream /healthz. Fine, informational.
Works as expected: 401 without cookie, 422 on empty prompt, 200 SSE with error event 'RateLimitError ... no credits remaining'.

ui_bugs.issue: Name empty: AI page shows 'Hi ! 👋' and Today shows 'Good afternoon, there' even after onboarding set display name 'Uitest User'/'Demo'. Local state.profile.displayName not populated from account profile; avatar shows 'Y'.
Hardcoded 'GPT-5' badge, inconsistent with selected 'GPT 6 Luna' / LifeOS Local
Long 'GPT 6 Luna unavailable: ...' toast text (URL) overflows the toast box on right edge; consider truncating/cleaning the litellm error message (e.g. 'OpenAI account has no credits')

integration_issues.issue: All app data (tasks, notes, AI conversations) stored only in browser localStorage under global key 'personalos:data' (packages/core/src/store/persistence.ts), not namespaced per user and not cleared on logout, and not synced to server. Different accounts on the same browser would share/see the same data; data does not follow the user across devices. Only the account/profile/onboarding persists server-side. Clarify with user given 'data must persist permanently' requirement.

Frontend log warns 'Blocked cross-origin request ... to /_next/* resource. configure allowedDevOrigins in next.config' for *.preview.emergentcf.cloud origins; page load event sometimes >10s. Add allowedDevOrigins.

issues: Landing says 'LifeOS', app header 'AI PersonalOS', onboarding 'PersonalOS' - inconsistent (user's code)

action_items: Review the cookie-jar fix in /app/backend/server.py (keep it) - critical security bug in proxy
Decide on per-user namespacing / clearing of localStorage 'personalos:data' on logout (and optionally server sync) so accounts don't share local data
Populate local profile displayName after login/onboarding so greetings show the user's name
Add allowedDevOrigins to apps/web next.config for preview domains
Optional: sanitize AI error message in toast; replace hardcoded 'GPT-5' badge on Tasks assistant
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: shared httpx client must never persist cookies (fixed).
ai-module.tsx run(): if SSE stream ends with no deltas and no error, UI stays on 'Thinking…' and message content is overwritten with ''. Fall back to result.message when full text is empty.
server.py proxy buffers entire upstream response (no streaming) - fine for JSON, but large exports will be held in memory.
server.py lifespan: if Fastify fails to start within 60s it silently continues; consider failing fast/logging.
